sig_3ce21f4b08ac4edf.raw_text: Ecommerce inventory spreadsheets fail as sales continue while the sheet is static. Brands with many SKUs, long supplier lead times or multiple channels (Shopify plus Amazon) face stockouts, overselling and reorder decisions from stale numbers. Spreadsheets that work at low volume break as channels and SKU count grow; Shopify shows unit counts but not when to reorder. [Market Discovery 2026 — ecommerce inventory spreadsheet pain]
sig_3ce21f4b08ac4edf.problem_statement: Ecommerce inventory spreadsheets fail as sales continue while the sheet is static.

sig_0394902d2b924911.raw_text: On a single sales channel, inventory spreadsheets often start cracking around roughly 200 orders per month because daily manual updates lag. With two channels, cross-channel sync must happen within minutes or the last unit sells twice. Common failure modes: missed updates, broken formulas, stale quantities, and tab mismatches between Shopify and Amazon. [Market Discovery 2026 — spreadsheet break points by volume]
sig_0394902d2b924911.problem_statement: On a single sales channel, inventory spreadsheets often start cracking around roughly 200 orders per month because daily manual updates lag.

sig_cf58b7867a9f4d2a.raw_text: Most freelancers experience late client payments at least occasionally; industry analyses commonly report that a large share of freelance invoices are paid past due and that freelancers spend substantial annual hours chasing payment. Late payment is often administrative — invoices lost in AP, missing portal entry, approval queues — not pure refusal to pay. Automated reminder sequences and clearer terms reduce delays but full accounting suites may be heavier than a lightweight receivables tracker needs. [Market Discovery 2026 — freelancer late invoices]

Market is crowded with FreshBooks, Bonsai, Wave and similar; any micro-product must be narrower than full invoicing suites. [Market Discovery 2026 — cost of chasing freelance payments]
